posts.message: Aberdare National Park protects critical water towers and wildlife in Kenya.
posts.action: Plan a weekend visit to explore the waterfalls and bamboo forests.
beats: The Aberdare National Park offers *stunning* mountain views and wildlife.
The park covers over 700 square kilometres of forest and moorland.
It is located in Nyeri and Nyandarua counties, open daily for visitors.
posts.line: The Aberdare *forests* supply water to millions of homes.
posts.fact: Established in 1950, the park covers 767 square kilometres and sits between 2,000 and 4,000 metres above sea level.
posts.caption:
Kenya at its best: The Aberdare ranges protect our rivers and wildlife. Save this for your next road trip.

#KenyaAtItsBest #KenyaOnRecord
posts.impact: Protected water towers ensure steady water supply for millions of homes and farms.

posts.message: Verify viral health claims with the Ministry of Health before sharing.
posts.action: Check official Ministry of Health updates on confirmed outbreaks.
beats: A viral message claims unverified cures for *Ebola*.
The Ministry confirms cases are managed in quarantine.
Always verify health alerts through official channels.
Kenyans demand daily verified updates during outbreaks.
posts.claim: A viral WhatsApp message claims local herbal mixtures cure Ebola instantly without hospital care.
posts.claim_source: Forwarded text messages circulating in Nairobi university groups, October 2026
posts.truth: Ebola requires specialized medical isolation and treatment facilities.
proof: Ministry of Health confirmed 7 cases under quarantine observation in October 2026.
No herbal mixture has been approved by pharmacy boards to treat viral hemorrhagic fevers.
posts.pride: Follow advice from licensed medical professionals.
posts.caption:
Set It Straight: Do not share unverified health cures on WhatsApp. Check official Ministry of Health advisories first.

#SetItStraight #KenyaOnRecord
posts.impact: False health alerts endanger public safety and spread panic during outbreaks.

scripts.radio:
Habari za wiki hii kutoka Kenya on Record. Mimi ni mtangazaji wako, na leo tunaziangazia hizi nchi zetu na maisha ya kila siku.

Kwanza kabisa, tahadhari kwa wale wanaotafuta kazi nje ya nchi. Hii wiki kwenye kitengo chetu cha #usiibiwe, tunawakumbusha kuwa mawakala feki wanazidi kuwinda pesa za wananchi kwa ajili ya ajira ambazo hazipo. Tafadhali chunguza vizuri kabla hujatoa hata shilingi moja.

Kwenye upande wa mazingira, #kenya yetu inajivunia Msitu wa Aberdare ambao unalinda minara yetu ya maji na wanyamapori. Tunahitaji kuutunza kwa manufaa ya vizazi vijavyo. Ukija mjini Nairobi, barabara ya Nairobi Expressway imerahisisha usafiri wa kuvuka jiji kwa wengi wetu kila siku.

Pia, #scorecard inatukumbusha kuwa viongozi wa umma lazima wafuate maadili ya Sura ya Sita ya Katiba. Hakuna aliye juu ya sheria. Kwenye #glasspoll yetu wiki hii, wananchi wanapima kama mapana ya kisiasa (broad-based pact) yameleta huduma bora au yamenyamazisha uwajibikaji. Kando na hilo, mfumuko wa bei na gharama ya maisha bado viko kwenye vinywa vya Wakenya wengi.

Na mwisho kabisa, kwenye #straight, kabla hujasambaza taarifa yoyote ya virusi ya afya mtandaoni, thibitisha kwanza na Wizara ya Afya. Usiwe chanzo cha kueneza uongo.

*Ufupi kwa Kiswahili:* Wiki hii tunaangazia tahadhari dhidi ya mawakala feki wa ajira, umuhimu wa misitu ya Aberdare, uwajibikaji wa viongozi, na uhakiki wa habari za afya kutoka Wizara ya Afya kabla ya kusambaza.
scripts.voice_note: Wadau, mambo vipi? Hapa ni Kenya on Record. Wiki hii tuna mambo mazito manne ya kuzingatia. Kwanza, #usiibiwe: mawakala feki wanachukua pesa kwa ajili ya kazi za ng'ambo ambazo hazipo; tafadhali angalia sana. Pili, kwenye #glasspoll, mnazungumziaje bei za bidhaa sokoni na huu muungano mpana wa kisiasa? Je, unaleta huduma au unanyamazisha uwajibikaji? Tatu, #straight inatukumbusha tuhakikishe habari za afya kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya kabla ya kusambaza mtandaoni. Na mwisho, viongozi wetu kwenye #scorecard lazima wazingatie Sura ya Sita ya uadilifu. Tujadiliane hapa tuone ukweli uko wapi.
scripts.sms: USIIBIWE: Usitoe pesa kwa wakala wa kazi za nje kabla ya kuhakikisha kibali chake kutoka NTSA au Wizara ya Kazi. Linda pesa yako leo!
scripts.reels: Hali halisi ikoje mtaani wiki hii? Kwenye #glasspoll, Wakenya wanapima joto la mfumuko wa bei na kujiuliza ikiwa muungano mpana wa kisiasa unaleta huduma bora au unanyamazisha sauti za wananchi. Wakati huo huo, #scorecard inawakumbusha viongozi wetu kuwa viwango vya Sura ya Sita vya uadilifu havina hiari—ni lazima vifuatwe. Fuatilia Kenya on Record ujue ukweli.
